section: Section filter row - search form fixed width
description: The devotees search form (.section-search-form) is a fixed 220px wide. It is reset to 100% only at <=480px (line 5644). Between 481px and ~768px it stays 220px, which combined with the pills wrap is acceptable, but the fixed width has no reduction until 480px; at very narrow widths above 480 it could still crowd. Minor since it sits in a flex-wrap row.
suggestedFix: Allow it to grow/shrink in the wrapped row and cap rather than fix: .section-search-form { position: relative; flex: 1 1 200px; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; } (keeps desktop ~220 via flex-basis while remaining fluid below).

description: The shared table wrapper forces sideways scrolling on every wide table instead of collapsing to a stacked list, directly violating the no-horizontal-scroll and table-collapse requirements down to 250px.

section: th inline style constant (table header cells)
description: All table header cells use whiteSpace:nowrap; combined with .adm-table-wrap overflow-x:auto this keeps headers from wrapping and forces the table wider than a 250px viewport instead of collapsing.
Header title is whiteSpace:nowrap; a long page/section title cannot wrap and can push the header wider than 250px (font is reduced at breakpoints but text still cannot wrap).
